notes: Hub litert-community/MiniCPM-V-4.7-1B (upload commit 9d7638b2, 2026-10-13 23:16 JST; the tree's sha256 read back equal to the lane's shipped files, litertlm-convert minicpmv47_work/LANE.md §3). These rows are the lane's round-9 runs on the shipped bytes (K/out/ship, litertlm-convert minicpmv47_work/r9): the card's commands plus the manifest checks (r9/card_cmd_runlog.txt) and the mini re-gate (r9/regate/), one fresh process each, greedy (--temperature 0 where the gate script sets it), Mac Studio M4 Max. No benchmark ran on these bytes, so the throughput cells are null. The shipped files are a metadata-only re-pack of the files the lane measured (round 9: the chat template ends an assistant turn at <|im_end|> and puts its newline at the head of the next turn, so a second turn prefills the upstream template's tokens); the swap reports (r9/swap_MiniCPM-V-4.7-1B_int8.json) read TFLite raw bytes, tokenizer and ExecutorMetadata identical (tflite_weights_byte_identical True, llm_metadata_only_template_changed True); a single-turn prompt renders the same text before and after (r9/template_check_r9.json). Text-only file (the decoder with its embedding inside the graph, 12 signatures). For contrast (#174(3)): the measured pre-repack file 5d6f2220… on litert-lm 0.18.0 `benchmark -p 256 -d 256 --runs 3 --cache no` (r6/bench.md, quiet windows): GPU prefill 2019.51 / 2007.55 and decode 158.39 / 158.16 tok/s in two legs of one window, TTFT 0.1331 / 0.1338 s, init 93.3271 / 100.4196 s; CPU 723.37 / 51.06 tok/s, TTFT 0.3761 s, init 44.4096 s (the first CPU window overlapped another lane's build and is not used); 8 questions CPU 8/8 regex (r1/gate8q_cpu.json), GPU 7/8 and 7/8 regex in two rounds with the miss = the fp32 model's own rhyme answer (r1/GATE.md); one of 20 fresh GPU processes answered the capital question with an extra word (r1/flake_gpu_capital_japan.txt). Not run on a phone.
quantization: text decoder only (no vision): dynamic-range int8 weights on 151 fully connected layers including the untied output head, the 36 GatedDeltaNet decay/gate projections (in_proj_a, in_proj_b) kept float, token embedding int8 per channel inside the graph, fp32 activation preference
